name: Add error handling to async fetcher
description: Add structured try/catch error handling to fetchUserProfile in src/fetcher.ts to handle network or promise rejections safely.

inputs.task_prompt: Update fetchUserProfile in src/fetcher.ts to safely wrap the async operation in a try/catch block. If the fetch operation succeeds, return { success: true, data: result, error: null }. If it throws or rejects, catch the error and return { success: false, data: null, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) }. Do not let errors throw unhandled.

acceptance_criteria: fetchUserProfile returns success: true and data on resolve
fetchUserProfile returns success: false and error message on reject
fetchUserProfile never throws an unhandled rejection
